answer.rationale: Roll out the shortened, simplified self-serve onboarding for SMB accounts. It has confirmed gains in completion, time-to-value, early adoption, and 30-day retention, making it the strongest available response for sustainable qualified revenue without reinforcing price-only acquisition. Do not counter with promotional pricing: the directly relevant prior test lifted acquisition but reduced 30-day retention by 12%. This will not prove that price-driven churn is eliminated, but it improves realized value for the SMB base while preserving long-term cohort quality.
